record.original_question: For a GO-space X, characterize exactly when X is cleavable over the real line R, meaning that for every subset A of X there is a continuous real-valued map f_A on X such that f_A(x) is not equal to f_A(y) whenever x is in A and y is in X minus A.

evidence.quote: A space X is cleavable over M [1] if for each subset A ⊆ X, there is a continuous fA from X into some member of M such that fA(x) 6= fA(y) for each x ∈ A and y ∈ X\A.
Question 5. Characterize GO spaces that are cleavable over R, i.e., in which the cleaving functions fA can always be taken to be mappings into R.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Definitions. A linearly ordered topological space (LOTS) is a triple (X, <, τ) where < is a linear order on X and τ is the topology on X generated by the open intervals with respect to <. A generalized ordered space (GO-space) is a triple (X, <, τ) where < is a linear order on X and τ is a topology on X that has a base of order-convex sets and that refines the open interval topology induced by <.

Let M be a class of topological spaces. A topological space X is said to be cleavable over M if for every subset A ⊆ X there exist a space Y ∈ M and a continuous map f_A : X → Y such that f_A(x) ≠ f_A(y) whenever x ∈ A and y ∈ X \ A. When M = {ℝ} (the real line with its usual topology), this means: for every A ⊆ X there is a continuous function f_A : X → ℝ with f_A(x) ≠ f_A(y) for all x ∈ A and all y ∈ X \ A.

Problem. Give an intrinsic characterization, in terms of the order-theoretic and topological structure of X, of those GO-spaces X that are cleavable over ℝ.
artifact.status_search_result: Cleavability of GO-spaces has been studied (e.g., the paper "Cleavability in Ordered Spaces" and related works characterize cleavability of GO-spaces over the class of metrizable spaces and over the rationals and irrationals), but no full intrinsic characterization of GO-spaces cleavable specifically over ℝ appears in the literature; the question is listed as an open problem and no resolution was located.

status_evidence.title: Cleavability in Ordered Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the role of cleavability and divisibility in the topology of generalized ordered (GO-) spaces, characterizing cleavability over various classes including metrizable spaces and the irrationals/rationals.
status_evidence.claim: Cleavability has been characterized for several target classes for GO-spaces, but the case of cleavability over ℝ is treated as a separate, still-open characterization problem.

status_evidence.title: On cleavability
status_evidence.snippet: Survey/thesis on cleavability and its role for ordered and generalized ordered spaces.
status_evidence.claim: No intrinsic characterization of GO-spaces cleavable over ℝ is provided; the problem remains stated as open.
